updates.intro: The installed version, new ones and when they install. Before installing, it waits for running jobs to finish, backs up the database and, if the new version does not start, goes back to the previous one on its own.
updates.notUpdatedHere: This installation is not updated from here (online edition or development environment).
updates.failedOnce: · it failed here once and is not retried automatically
updates.timeZoneFromPlatform: The platform's time zone (Settings → Platform, or `server timezone set` on the server).
updates.drainHelp: If they do not finish in that time, the update is postponed without touching anything.
updates.ready: New version downloaded and verified, ready to install
updates.draining: Waiting for running jobs to finish
updates.checkingNewVersionResponds: Checking that the new version responds
updates.newVersionDidNot: The new version did not respond: going back to the previous one
updates.failedCritical: It failed and could not go back: the server needs checking
updates.rolledBack: Went back to the previous one
updates.withApprovalHelp: Each new version is announced and installed when an administrator clicks «Update».
updates.automaticHelp: It installs by itself within the window, when no jobs are running.
updates.manualHelp: Notification only; it is installed with «orquestador actualizar» on the server.
updates.requestSent: Request sent: it starts in less than a minute
updates.reloadPage: reload the page to use the new interface
updates.drainNotice: It waits for running jobs to finish (up to {{maxDrainSecs}} min; anything started in the meantime stays queued), backs up the database and installs. If the new version does not start, it goes back to the previous one on its own. Quality Data does not respond for a few minutes.
updates.serviceSilent: The update service has not responded since {{formatDate}}. Check it on the server with
updates.maintenanceSince: Since {{formatDate}}: new jobs wait in the queue and run when it finishes.
updates.updateRequested: «Update» clicked {{r}}on {{formatDate}} : the server's service picks it up in less than a minute.
updates.scheduleGuard: Don't start if a schedule is due in the next (min)
updates.pausedHelp: Paused: don't install automatically for now (the button still works)
updates.drainMinutes: Wait for jobs to finish for up to (min)

api.chunkTooLarge: The chunk exceeds the allowed size.

updateProgress.checkingNewVersionResponds: Checking that the new version responds
updateProgress.rollingBack: No response: going back to the previous one
updateProgress.restarting: The API is restarting with the new version
updateProgress.pickedUpSoon: the server's service picks it up in less than a minute
updateProgress.failedCritical: It failed and could not go back

updateNotice.updating: Updating Quality Data ({{reason}}). Anything started now stays queued and runs when it finishes, in a few minutes.
updateNotice.failedCritical: The last update failed and could not go back on its own: the server needs checking.
updateNotice.rolledBack: Version {{version}} did not start and it went back to {{from}}. Nothing was lost.
updateNotice.failedOnce: It failed here once: it can be retried.
updateNotice.installsInWindow: It installs by itself in the next window.
updateNotice.installByCommand: It is installed with «orquestador actualizar» on the server.
